     3| *
     4| * FINAL IVX IA CHAT EXECUTION MODE mandate (owner 2026-07-19):
     5| *   "Remove all narrative planning responses for requests classified as Developer."
     6| *
     7| * When the owner's prompt matches one of the 10 execution categories, the chat
     8| * becomes an EXECUTION CONSOLE — never a planning assistant. The 10 categories
     9| * are the owner's exact list:
    10| *
    11| *   fix · build · deploy · audit · QA · refactor · migration ·
    12| *   create module · create app · senior developer
    13| *
    14| * For any matched category the chat MUST:
    15| *   1. Classify the intent  →  this module.
    16| *   2. Create a persistent worker job  →  ivx-senior-developer-worker queue.
    17| *   3. Return HTTP 202 with taskId immediately  →  ivx-owner-ai.ts.
    18| *   4. Begin execution  →  worker drain loop.
    19| *   5. Stream live execution status  →  executionStatus JSON + statusUrl.
    20| *   6. Return only verified evidence from the worker.
    21| *
    22| * Pure + deterministic (no I/O, no AI gateway) so it is fully unit-testable.
    23| */
    24|
    25|/** The 11 owner-mandated execution categories (10 execution + 1 read-only inspection). */
    26|export type IVXExecutionModeCategory =
    27|  | 'fix'
    28|  | 'build'
    29|  | 'deploy'
    30|  | 'audit'
    31|  | 'qa'
    32|  | 'refactor'
    33|  | 'migration'
    34|  | 'create_module'
    35|  | 'create_app'
    36|  | 'senior_developer'
    37|  | 'developer_inspection';
    38|
    39|export type IVXExecutionModeClassification = {
    40|  /** True when the prompt matches any of the 10 execution categories. */
    41|  isExecutionMode: boolean;
    42|  /** The matched category, or null when not an execution-mode prompt. */
    43|  category: IVXExecutionModeCategory | null;
    44|  /** Human-readable label for the matched category (for audit/proof). */
    45|  categoryLabel: string;
    46|  /** The exact trigger phrase that fired the classification (for proof). */
    47|  matchedTrigger: string;
    48|  /** Human-readable reason for the classification (audit trail). */
    49|  reason: string;
    50|};
    51|
    52|/**
    53| * Category matchers, ordered most-specific first so "create module" wins over
    54| * bare "create" and "QA" wins over a generic "fix" mention. Each pattern is
    55| * anchored to whole-phrase semantics (no substring false positives).
    56| *
    57| * CRITICAL: the owner's mandate bans narrative planning for these categories.
    58| * A match means the chat returns HTTP 202 + taskId + executionStatus JSON —
    59| * never a conversational implementation plan.
    60| */
    61|const CATEGORY_PATTERNS: Array<{
    62|  category: IVXExecutionModeCategory;
    63|  label: string;
    64|  pattern: RegExp;
    65|}> = [
    66|  // ── Most specific composite intents first ──────────────────────────────
    67|  {
    68|    category: 'create_module',
    69|    label: 'create module',
    70|    // "create a module", "create module", "build a new module", "add module X"

    72|      /\b(?:create|build|add|scaffold|make|generate)\b[^.]{0,30}\b(?:a\s+)?(?:new\s+)?(?:module|feature|service|component)\b/i,

    80|  },

    84|    pattern:

    93|  },
    94|  {

    96|    label: 'refactor',
    97|    pattern:
    98|      /\b(?:refactor|refactoring|refactored|clean\s+up\s+(?:the\s+)?code|restructure(?:d)?\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:code|module|service)|reorganiz(?:e|ing|ed)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:code|module|service))\b/i,

   135|function normalize(value: string): string {
   136|  return (typeof value === 'string' ? value : '').trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');

   139|/**
   140| * Classify an owner prompt into one of the 10 execution-mode categories.
   141| *
   142| * The first matching category wins (patterns are ordered most-specific first).
   143| * Returns `isExecutionMode: false` when the prompt is a normal conversation,
